description: 787daily's glossary of Puerto Rico Spanish for English readers: the weather service's alert words (aviso = warning, advertencia = advisory, vigilancia = watch — a translation often swaps them), AAA's reservoir bands (seguridad, observación, ajustes, control), the agencies' and public bodies' Spanish names and initials (CRIM, DACO, AAA, AEE …) and civic words (patente, IVU, municipio). Each term with the English the site uses for it, a one-line definition and its link. `term` finds one by its Spanish, its initials or its English, accents optional; `group` lists a section; neither lists all (about 70). Cite 787daily.com/learn/glossary/.

group.description: One section: weather, water, agencies, recovery, civic

term.description: A Spanish word or phrase, initials or the English, e.g. 'advertencia', 'CRIM' or 'flood watch'
